description: We are Software Engineering and Electrical & Computer Engineering students teaming up to present an engaging, school-friendly narrative of NASA's historical abandoned equipment on the Moon and Mars through technology.
summary:
Ghosts of the Void is an interactive educational platform designed to preserve and share the stories of seven historic, discarded space relics on the Moon and Mars.
Developed for the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge, the platform addresses a major barrier in space education: vital mission histories and scientific milestones are often scattered across fragmented archives and dense technical records that overwhelm students. Using NASA open data, Ghosts of the Void brings these pioneering spacecraft together in one intuitive, visually engaging space—allowing learners to explore mission sites, inspect forgotten hardware, and understand their scientific legacies through accessible storytelling.
This project matters because space exploration is built on the foundations laid by early missions that too often fade from public memory. By transforming complex archival data into an interactive, human-centered experience, Ghosts of the Void ensures that students everywhere can easily discover, understand, and draw inspiration from the pioneers who paved the way for modern spaceflight.
details:
Ghosts of the Void is an interactive educational website designed to help students and space enthusiasts explore abandoned and forgotten space technology. Throughout the history of space exploration, several remarkable machines have completed their missions, lost communication, or remained on distant worlds. However, finding reliable and organized information about these forgotten technologies can be challenging, especially for students.

Our website addresses this problem by bringing information about these space relics together in one accessible and engaging platform. Users can explore different missions, discover the stories behind forgotten spacecraft and rovers, learn important mission details, and access official NASA resources for further research. The platform also features a multi-filter exploration system that allows users to discover relics based on different categories. Additionally, users can complete a seven-relic learning journey and receive a certificate after completing their exploration.

The primary benefit of our project is making authentic space-related information easier to discover, understand, and explore. Instead of searching through multiple websites, students can access organized information in one place. By combining educational content with interactive exploration, we aim to make space science more engaging and encourage independent learning.

Our intended impact is to preserve the stories of forgotten space technology while inspiring a new generation of learners to develop an interest in space exploration, science, and research. We believe that even when a mission ends, the knowledge and achievements it leaves behind should not be forgotten.

Tools and Technologies Used:

HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for website development.

Google Gemini for AI-assisted coding, debugging, content organization, and development support.

NASA Science website for scientific information and mission research.

NASA Image and Video Library for visual resources.

NASA Official Website for additional mission information.

Figma for interface planning and design.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of Ghosts of the Void lies in transforming the concept of abandoned space technology into an interactive learning experience. Rather than presenting forgotten missions as a conventional collection of articles, we designed an exploration-based platform where users can discover each relic's story. The seven-relic learning journey and certificate feature introduce an element of achievement and motivation, making the learning process more engaging.

Factors Considered During Development:

Our team considered the needs of students, accessibility of scientific information, accuracy of mission details, simplicity of navigation, visual engagement, and educational value. We also prioritized using credible NASA resources, creating an understandable interface, and making the platform useful for both beginners and people interested in space exploration.

Ultimately, Ghosts of the Void is built around one idea: a mission may end, but its story deserves to live on.
